name: 蘇浚生
objective:
中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年 (一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年 (一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。

The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          1. 第 17 週：學生於 MyCT 平台完成《來學華語》第二冊第 1-5 課朗讀錄音，系統依發音、語調、流利度、重音評分，作為期末口語成績參考。
2. 第 18 週：學生完成第二冊第 1-5 課聽力與閱讀作業本，依完成情形與正確度作為期末作業成績參考。

1. Week 17: Read-aloud recordings of Lessons 1-5, Let's Learn Mandarin 2, on MyCT; rated on pronunciation, intonation, fluency, stress.
2. Week 18: Lessons 1-5 listening and reading workbook; graded on completion and accuracy.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          1. 學生須於第 17 週結束前，於 MyCT 平台完成《來學華語》第二冊第一課至第五課全部課文朗讀錄音之提交。
2. 學生須於第 18 週上課前，繳交《來學華語》第二冊第一課至第五課之聽力與閱讀作業本。

1. By the end of Week 17, students must submit all read-aloud recordings for the texts in Lessons 1–5 of Let’s Learn Mandarin 2 through the MyCT platform.
2. Students must submit the listening and reading workbook for Lessons 1–5 of Let’s Learn Mandarin 2 before the Week 18 class.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          1. 第 17 週口語朗讀: 20%
2. 第 18 週聽力與閱讀作業本: 10%

1. Week 17 Oral Reading: 20%
2. Week 18 Listening and Reading Workbook: 10%
